raw: It feels like a showroom. Cold, loud, every fingerprint shows on the gloss.
Me and my husband. His brother eats with us most Sundays.
I cook, he sits at the island on his laptop. Lights are all on full because the dimmer is broken.
Warm and lived-in. Somewhere you would want to linger after dinner.
Talking. It echoes. Hard floor, hard counters, nothing soft anywhere.
The island and the counters. They cost a fortune and they work fine.
Six thousand at most. We are not replacing cabinets.
